purpose: Add a genuinely global parity-sensitive layer after implication and pair-probe closure. Encode every width<=3 clause as its Boolean falsity polynomial over GF(2), Gaussian-eliminate the polynomial row span in the O(n^3)-dimensional multilinear degree<=3 monomial space, reject when the constant polynomial 1 appears, and extract affine-linear consequences for the existing implication layer. This detects global cancellations such as Tseitin parity contradictions that are invisible to local propagation.

boolean_quotient.ring: B_n=GF(2)[x_1,...,x_n]/(x_i^2-x_i). Every monomial is represented squarefreely.
boolean_quotient.clause_polynomial: For C=(l_1 OR ... OR l_t), t<=3, put f_C=product_j false(l_j). A Boolean assignment satisfies C iff f_C evaluates to 0.
boolean_quotient.ambient_dimension: Every f_C is multilinear of degree at most three, so all rows live in the vector space spanned by squarefree monomials of degree <=3. Its dimension is sum_{i=0}^3 binom(n,i)=O(n^3).

algorithm.span: Build the GF(2) coefficient matrix with one row per f_C and one column per degree<=3 squarefree monomial; compute a row-echelon basis.
algorithm.unsat_terminal: Test whether the constant polynomial 1 lies in the row span. If yes, store the corresponding GF(2) combination of input clauses as a certificate and return UNSAT.
algorithm.affine_extraction: Compute the intersection of the clause-polynomial span with the affine-linear subspace span{1,x_1,...,x_n}. Every resulting equation b+sum a_i x_i=0 is an exact affine consequence of F. Gaussian elimination on these consequences detects affine inconsistency and exposes weight-1/weight-2 consequences that can be translated to unit/equality/disequality 2-CNF constraints and fed back to the SCC/pair kernel.
algorithm.iteration: After adding any new unary/binary affine consequence, rerun the already frozen implication-primitive, width3-resolution and pair-conditioned kernels, then rebuild the clause span if the formula changed.
algorithm.runtime: Polynomial: the coefficient space has O(n^3) columns, ordinary GF(2) Gaussian elimination is polynomial, and there are only O(n^2) possible unary/binary consequences to add.

theorem.name: GF2_BOOLEAN_CLAUSE_SPAN_UNSAT_AND_AFFINE_CONSEQUENCE_KERNEL
soundness: Every model of F zeros every row polynomial f_C.
Therefore every GF(2)-linear combination of the f_C also vanishes on every model.
If 1 belongs to the span, a model would have to satisfy 1=0, impossible; hence the formula is UNSAT.
Every extracted affine-linear row is likewise entailed by F, so adding its unary/binary consequences preserves the model set.
theorem.certificate: A span refutation is a subset/XOR combination of input clause-polynomial rows equal to 1. Verification expands at most degree-three multilinear polynomials and XORs their O(n^3)-coordinate vectors, hence is polynomial.

strict_global_gain.control: The v4.0 K4 Tseitin contradiction: six edge variables, four degree-three parity constraints encoded by sixteen 3-clauses, with odd total vertex charge.
strict_global_gain.pair_and_resolution_state: Complete width<=3 resolution derives no new clause, and every consistent singleton/pair assumption remains unit-propagation consistent.
strict_global_gain.local_block_identity: For each cubic vertex v, XORing its four CNF clause-polynomials cancels all quadratic/cubic terms and yields the affine equation XOR_{e incident v} x_e = charge(v).
strict_global_gain.global_identity: XORing the four vertex equations cancels every edge variable exactly twice and leaves the constant 1 because the total charge is odd. Equivalently, XORing all sixteen clause-polynomials gives 1.
strict_global_gain.consequence: The GF2 clause-span terminal refutes this explicit pair-closed width3-closed UNSAT core by one polynomial Gaussian elimination.

scientific_ceiling.not_complete: Constant-degree algebraic reasoning is not a universal SAT refutation method. Polynomial-calculus/PCR degree lower bounds are known for expanding/random k-CNFs and other standard contradictions, so a fixed low-degree linear-algebra layer cannot be promoted to D1.
scientific_ceiling.anti_loop: Failure of the span test is SILENCE, not SAT evidence. Do not infer affine structure merely because no contradiction is found.

next_target.name: E8_LOW_DEGREE_CLOSED_NONAFFINE_GLOBAL_CONTRACTION_V4_2
next_target.directive: Attack only cores surviving implication closure, width3 resolution, pair-conditioned propagation, and GF2 clause-span affine elimination. The next operation must compress genuinely higher-degree/non-affine correlations without enumerating monomials of unbounded degree. Seek a polynomial-size global invariant, topology-changing contraction, or minimax certificate with exact witness reconstruction.
